title: A cutaway must be genuinely silent
text: The user's studio cutaways are longer shots of the same scene from nearby (8-16 s, 15-26 s away), not 2-3 s pops. Listener shots picked by voice labels showed people talking out of sync. Check every cutaway frame by eye before using it; a masked speaker's own continuous picture can carry tightened sound.
